Which patients went to the ED with low back pain, were discharged home, and had no physical therapy within 60 days? Definition: ED visit = payer claim with place of service 23, revenue code 045x or CPT 99281-99285, service date in the 12 months before as_of and at least 60 days before as_of, with M54.5* on the claim. Discharged home = no inpatient admission (TOB 011x/012x or ADT inpatient) starting that day or the next. PT = CPT 97161-97164, 97110, 97112, 97140, 97530 on any claim line with service in the 60 days after the visit.

row.question: Which patients with a PHQ-9 of 10 or more had no follow-up within 30 days? Definition: PHQ-9 total >= 10 dated 30 to 365 days before as_of, with no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) and no behavioral health claim (CPT 90791, 90792, 90832-90838, 90846, 90847, 90853) on days 1-30 after it. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone, virtual and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.
